verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs state that Checkout can be embedded on your own site instead of redirecting to a Stripe-hosted page. They also say Elements lets you build a fully customized payment page, so the core of embedding customizable components on a website is directly supported. Coverage is incomplete, however: the evidence never addresses embedding in native or mobile apps, and the customization claim is a one-line headline without detail. Missing for 10: evidence of embeddable components for native/mobile apps, documented depth of component customization (styling/appearance options), independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedded flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: Customers enter their payment details in a fully-featured payment page, either embedded on your site or via a redirect to a Stripe-hosted page.
Elements: Build a fully customized payment page using elements
